title: The JVM constant pool's long and double reserve two index bits
summary: CONSTANT_Long and CONSTANT_Double occupy two numbers in the constant pool table; the next number is not available.
applies: JVM class files and standard bytecode
detail: An entry starts at #7, then #8 cannot be referenced, and the next available number is #9. Constant pool numbers start from 1.
boundary: There is only one structure for this constant in the class file; there is no need to read a label from the file for the reserved number.
relevance: Explain why the number of indexes and the number of parsed entries differ when locating the latter string or method reference.
